open.q: In your own words: what are the three things every tool must have, and what does each do?
open.a:
Description: Describes when and why the tool is used in natural language for the model. 
inputSchema: Describes what data can be used in the tool to find the correct answer
Execute: Excecutes the functions necessary to complete the tool and return desired data
